note: s44's DETERMINISTIC gates — the only bench numbers allowed to fail a PR (D5). Everything wall-derived (ns/op, speedups, geomeans, the X3 delta, the sentinel delta, LLVM's wall share) is report-only and lives in the nightly report JSON. `cargo xtask bench-gates` recomputes these and fails on regression.

ir_volume.why_not_a_hard_gate: The contract (#70 metric 1) budgets the LLVM IR handed to LLVM at <= 50% of the naive s41 lowering. Measured at s44: 57.7% over the corpus, 87.5% over the 13 hot kernels; re-measured at s79: 58.2% over the corpus (n=107) and 86.8% over the kernels, i.e. unmoved across four sprints. Asserting 0.50 today would make every commit red without telling anyone anything new, so the gate is a RATCHET at the measured value plus slack, and the shortfall is reported as an open item (see bench/loss-ledger.md, gap G1). Tighten the ceiling whenever the mid-end earns it; the contract target stays recorded here so nobody forgets what it was.
ir_volume.corpus_ceiling_history: 0.600 (s79, n=107) -> 0.630 (s86, n=132). The move is a POPULATION change, not a mid-end regression, and the split is recorded so it cannot be mistaken for one: the 14 conc programs that s86's `func.addr` lowering made compilable on Tier-R entered this measurement for the first time and sit at geomean 0.900 (nothing to fold — those bodies are opaque `__wolf_rt_*` calls), while the other 117 run-phase entries are still 0.582, unchanged. Anyone tempted to read this ceiling as slack should check the non-conc number first; `conc/proc_link.lu` at 1.385 is the one entry where the mid-end makes a body BIGGER, and it is filed in bench/loss-ledger.md under family F.

vectorization_witnesses.note: report 10 delta 2. Deterministic, so it gates: a loop that stops vectorizing fails here before wall time moves on the current machine. `wolf` counts remarks from `clang -x ir -O2` on the module the backend actually emits; `c_naive` from `clang -O3` on ref.c. A wolf count of 0 across the board was the s44 finding, not the s44 target — the floors were recorded so the first kernel that started vectorizing would be visible. s75 is that moment: `alias_daxpy` vectorizes now that element access is `ptr.off` + `load` instead of a runtime call, and its floor ratchets to 1. s85 is the second: `e1_sum_reduce` vectorizes because its overflow check is GONE — proven away by the trip-scaled accumulator bound, not switched off — which is the falsifiable form of D44's claim that the check was the only thing stopping LoopVectorize. Its floor ratchets to 1, so a range analysis that regresses fails here rather than in a nightly wall number. The rest stay at 0 with a reason each, in bench/loss-ledger.md: `aos_dot` is a float reduction LLVM will not reassociate, `a2_stencil1d` still carries a bounds guard the relational analysis cannot discharge (`i <u out.len` against a loop guarded by `src.len - 1`, and the program never relates the two lengths, so no closure over the known relations can decide it — it wants a version guard on the invariant PAIR, wolf-lang#98) plus two overflow traps on `int` elements that carry no width bound, `a5_hoist_call` was recorded as 'has a call in the loop by construction' and the s79 audit found that to be false — both lanes fold the callee away (wolf-lang#97).

instantiations.note: s93 (D8's health metric, s43 T3's last bullet): `wir_instantiations_seen` is every (generic callee, substitution) demand a call site pushed onto the worklist; `wir_instantiations_lowered` is the distinct bodies the drain emitted. Measured over the corpus at s93: seen 7, lowered 6 — generics/first_of_list 1/1, generics/two_instances 3/2 (two integer-typed sites of `pick` collapse onto `pick.mono.i32`), and one instance each in traits/adapter_distinct, assoc_rewrite and show_bound that lowered as far as their c06 dispatch gap. rows/hof_tail and comptime/norm_linear push NOTHING: an earlier c06 refusal in the same body (a fn value as an argument; a type outside WIR) aborts before their generic call is reached.
instantiations.not_yet_a_dedup_ratio: This is WORKLIST IDEMPOTENCE only — N call sites of one callee under one key emit one body. It is NOT the D8 dedup ratio (instantiations that are layout-identical after the mid-end collapsing to one representative); s94 adds `unique` and the ratio then reads seen/unique. Until s94 lands, do not read `seen/lowered` as anything but 'the drain does not emit duplicates'. Population-note discipline as for corpus_ceiling_history: a move in these numbers is a corpus change unless a commit says otherwise.
